preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i] <= i for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array must be a non-negative integer and must not exceed its index i.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] <= a[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The array a must be non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid else ' '.join(map(str, b))
postconditions.description: If no valid array b exists, output -1; otherwise, output the array b as a space-separated string.

postconditions.expression: all(MEX(b[:i + 1]) == a[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each index i, the MEX of the first i+1 elements of b must equal a_i.
